reviewed.purpose: Optional Priya garden about 36 square feet and source estimation activities.
reviewed.previousDefect: Candidate falsely changed 36 ft² benchmark to 30 ft², with four invented options. It also omitted 7×12 8/9 and 9×4 2/29 estimation and source 2,3,5,6,7 digit puzzle.
reviewed.repair: Original four areas 42,35,35,24 ft²; explicit strict budget ≤36 accepts B/C/D, but source language 'reasonable near 36' could support emphasizing B/C only. First-party narrative preserves teacher judgment rather than declaring D automatically correct. Restored exact 90 2/9, 36 18/29, sample 6×3 2/5=20 2/5.
reviewed.boundary: Original student task image, key and human rubric not independently checked; the distinction between admissible under budget and sufficiently close to target is explicitly open.
